description: PUBLIC, NO API KEY required. Same as check_domain_public but checks up to 50 domains in ONE call (faster + fewer rate-limit hits). Returns an array where each item has availability, price, renewal price, registrar, and a clickable buyUrl. ALWAYS prefer this over multiple check_domain_public calls when you have more than one candidate. For 5 brandable .ai suggestions, this is one call instead of five.

domains.description: Array of fully-qualified domains to check, e.g. ['taskflow.ai','codeflow.ai','shipsync.ai']

name: check_domains_public_bulk
